scope: Redacted managed Cloud Spanner SPANNER_SYS observations from managed-cycle-20260917 (post-integration run); counts only, no database identifiers.

producers: direct INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS queries with TABLE_SCHEMA='SPANNER_SYS' through spanner-mycli

added_column_pattern.distribution_type: ARRAY<STRUCT<COUNT INT64, MEAN FLOAT64, SUM_OF_SQUARED_DEVIATION FLOAT64, NUM_FINITE_BUCKETS INT64, GROWTH_FACTOR FLOAT64, SCALE FLOAT64, BUCKET_COUNTS ARRAY<INT64>>>
added_column_pattern.placement: appended after the last previously known column of each table; no ordinal or type change for existing columns

check_runs.surface_delta: not available for legacy baselines (hash and count only)

type_query_samples.query: SELECT COLUMN_NAME, SPANNER_TYPE, COUNT(*) ... FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='SPANNER_SYS' AND COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%_DISTRIBUTION%' GROUP BY 1,2 with a scalar subquery counting all SPANNER_SYS columns
type_query_samples.note: The SPANNER_SYS surface flaps between 539 and 587 columns across consecutive strong reads, like the INFORMATION_SCHEMA IS_INHERITED rollout observed in the same window.

repository_contract_notes.manifest_required_targets: managed and omni legacy v0alpha1 sidecars; buildManifestColumn fails closed when required targets disagree on presence, so managed-only columns cannot become observed_both until an Omni release exposes them
repository_contract_notes.descriptor_superset_policy: survey/spannersys structs hold the superset of all known columns; registry-known columns absent from a target are known_absent, not drift
